name: GREENTEC
recent: Greentronics 于2026年9月以200万令吉现金收购 Tujuan RE 51%股权，后者将成为间接子公司。2026年11月，执行主席 Dato' Goh Soo Wee 在闭市期增持2883万股及3679万张凭单。同期，凭单C分两批行使，合计发行约63.9万股新股。
notable: 以200万令吉现金收购 Tujuan RE 51%股权，后者将成为间接持股51%的子公司。
执行主席 Dato' Goh Soo Wee 在闭市期增持2883万股普通股及3679万张凭单C。
凭单C行使，分别于2026年11月24日及26日上市约20万股及43.86万股新股。
risks: 执行主席在闭市期增持股份及凭单，涉及董事交易。
凭单C行使导致新股发行，现有股东持股可能被稀释。
最新季度净亏损11.3万令吉，营收同比下滑64.5%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收541.6万令吉，环比下降10.6%，同比下降64.5%；净亏损11.3万令吉，净利率-2.1%，上季净利率为3.0%。

recent_en: Greentronics acquired a 51% stake in Tujuan RE for RM2 million cash in September 2026, making it an indirect subsidiary. In November 2026, Executive Chairman Dato' Goh Soo Wee acquired 28.83 million shares and 36.79 million warrants during the closed period. Meanwhile, Warrant C exercises in two tranches issued about 639,000 new shares.
notable_en: Acquired a 51% stake in Tujuan RE for RM2 million cash; Tujuan RE will become an indirect 51%-owned subsidiary.
Executive Chairman Dato' Goh Soo Wee acquired 28.83 million ordinary shares and 36.79 million Warrant C during the closed period.
Warrant C exercises listed about 200,000 and 438,600 new shares on 24 and 26 November 2026 respectively.
risks_en: The Executive Chairman acquired shares and warrants during the closed period, involving director dealings.
Warrant C exercises resulted in new share issuance, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM113,000 with revenue down 64.5% year-on-year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM5.416 million, down 10.6% QoQ and 64.5% YoY; net loss was RM113,000 with a net margin of -2.1%, versus 3.0% in the previous quarter.
